text:
GENERATE BURST L11-sky — Run C-9 P5, the SUNSET SKY, deeper and darker (Matt R-C9-29: darker mood; the sky scored plainer than the approved scene). task_id "L11-sky".

Paint ONE landscape 1536x1024 image: the sunset sky, the farthest backdrop of a game scene, in the painted hand of IMAGE 1 but DEEPER and DARKER, matching the mood of IMAGE 2. Exactly ONE sun: a small molten-gold disc LOW near the LEFT edge, half-sunk behind a cloud bank, with an intense gold-orange glow around it. A narrow burning band of gold, orange and crimson along the LOWER quarter; above it the sky darkens quickly through rose and deep magenta into rich violet and a deep indigo at the TOP. Layered, heavy clouds of many DIFFERENT shapes and sizes, their undersides lit crimson and gold, their tops in deep violet shadow; a purple smoky haze in the lower sky. Exactly TWO immense columns of dark smoke rising from below the RIGHT half of the bottom edge (a burning cathedral and a burning castle out of frame), different shapes, lit orange from below, leaning with the wind — NOT parallel stripes. NO land, NO stars, no text, no border. Rich, deep colour — never pastel.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if there is more than one sun, the smoke columns are parallel stripes or repeat, the clouds form repeated rows, or it reads pastel/pale — name the reason. Copy the output to out/L11-sky.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "L11-sky"; images = the file with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — the current sky: painted hand only (to be made deeper and darker)
IMAGE 2 — the approved dark sunset mood (Matt); colour and darkness only
